device_entry.description: LabJack多功能数据采集模块是一种带模拟与数字输入输出接口的实验室数据采集和控制设备，可用于读取传感器电压信号、输出模拟控制电压，以及控制或监测数字开关量，常用于通用自动化、仪器联动和实验数据采集。
device_entry.description_en: A LabJack multifunction DAQ module is a laboratory data acquisition and control device with analog and digital I/O. It is used to read sensor voltages, output analog control voltages, and control or monitor digital logic signals in general automation, instrument integration, and experimental data acquisition.
